label: Raise hand
intent: A teammate puts their hand up to ask for the floor. Light: the arm shoots up from the shoulder until the hand is above the shoulder beside the head, stops with a hit and a small rebound, holds, then drops back down with a hit. Strong: a short wind-up, the arm shoots up harder as the body straightens, the hand waves twice at the top ('pick me'), then drops back with a hit and a small bounce.

person.//: Strong only: the teammate straightens as the hand goes up

arm.//: the arm swings from the shoulder; -140 degrees puts the hand up beside the head

motion.//: At -150 degrees the hand still clears the head by 0.4 at Bold.
